name: search2_charge
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd();plan={'queries':['"positive trace" "nearly symmetric" counterexample conjecture','"uniform spanning trees" "negative association" Feder Mihail proof','"Middle-coordinate" Milson simplex majorization conjecture']};p=lane/'search2-plan.json'
b=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());c=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert b['calls_used']==len(c) and b['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in c);print('LIVE authenticated',b)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),p.name],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'charge_search.py'),str(p)],text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0
